raw_counts_method: Loaded all_cells_qc.h5ad and analysis.h5ad independently; exact sparse element equality for retained barcodes and all genes.

pbmc5k_seed_review.interpretation: Seed sensitivity is concentrated in redistribution between neighboring clusters; the predeclared ARI screen still fails. No manual cell exclusions or gate relaxation.

repeat_check.scope: Same pinned environment, inputs, parameters, and code. Exact barcode QC, UMAP/cluster table, and marker reproducibility.

limitations: Local independent review, separate from immutable cloud run artifacts. No doublet truth, ambient correction, or independent cell-type truth.
